definitions.explanation: A Japanese-style omelet made by rolling thin layers of seasoned beaten egg in a rectangular pan. A staple of bento boxes and sushi toppings.

examples.japanese: {卵焼|たまごや}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{卵焼|たまごや}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。

examples.english: My mother's tamagoyaki was slightly sweet and had been my favorite food since childhood.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTES: One of the most common home-cooked Japanese dishes. Seasoning varies by region and family: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧ (eastern Japan) tends to make it sweet with sugar and ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧, while ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧ (western Japan) tends toward a more savory, ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧-flavored version called ⟦{出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}→出汁巻き卵：08601_dashimakitamago⟧.

A special rectangular pan called {卵焼|たまごや}き{器|き} is used to roll the layers. {卵焼|たまごや}き is also a popular sushi topping (⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧), especially at {築地|つきじ} and other famous markets.
